strings.system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Diagnostics
strings.system_checker_desc: Cikakken tabbaci na direbobi, kernel modules, izini, da dakunan karatu na lokacin aiki don tabbatar da ingantaccen walƙiya.
strings.settings_checker_desc_installer: Yana shirya kwamfutarka don haɗi zuwa mai kunnawa don sabunta software.
strings.settings_checker_desc_advanced: Yana duba saitin Linux na ci-gaba don SP Flash Tool, damar USB, izini na serial, da abubuwan tsarin.
strings.settings_checker_desc_friendly: Yana shirya kwamfutarka don haɗawa da mai kunnawa da shigar da sabunta software cikin dogaro.
strings.settings_checker_desc: Yana shirya injin walƙiya, sannan yana bincika damar USB, ƙungiyoyin masu amfani da samfuran serial kernel.
strings.linux_prep_starting: Ana shirya Kayan aikin Flash na SP…
strings.linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kwamfutarka a shirye take don haɗi zuwa mai kunnawa.

strings.linux_prep_connected_friendly: An samo mai kunnawa - damar haɗi mai sanyaya rai…

strings.linux_prep_blocked: Wannan kwamfutar ba za ta iya gudanar da SP Flash Tool ba.
strings.linux_prep_fix_body: Har yanzu ana buƙatar mataki ɗaya tushen: ka'idodin USB don na'urorin MediaTek da damar shiga tashar jiragen ruwa.
strings.linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Don saita wannan kwamfutar don SP Flash Tool, za a buƙaci kalmar sirrinku a mataki na gaba don daidaita ƙa'idodin USB da ƙara asusunku zuwa ƙungiyoyin masu amfani da ake buƙata. Idan kun ƙi, aikace-aikacen zai rufe.
strings.linux_prep_needs_access: Ba a ba da damar shiga ba - walƙiya yana buƙatar sa.
strings.linux_prep_fixed: An ba da damar shiga - SP Flash Tool yana shirye.
strings.linux_prep_reboot_body: Saita ya cika kuma an ƙara asusun ku zuwa ƙungiyoyin masu amfani da ake buƙata don Kayan aikin SP Flash. Da fatan za a sake kunna kwamfutarka don sabon izini ya fara aiki, sannan sake buɗe app ɗin. Danna alamar bincike don rufe ƙa'idar yanzu.
strings.linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Anyi - Rufe App don Sake kunna Kwamfuta
strings.settings_driver_desc: Kafin amfani da app a karon farko, dole ne ka shigar da direban USB na MediaTek, sannan ka sake yi kwamfutarka.

strings.settings_guided_install_desc: App ɗin yana kasancewa tare da ku ta hanyar kashe wuta, haɗawa, da shigarwa.
strings.settings_sp_gui_install: Shigar a cikin SP Flash Tool GUI
strings.settings_sp_gui_desc: Yana rufe Sabunta CE kuma yana buɗe SP Flash Tool GUI tare da zaɓin fayil ɗin firmware da aka riga aka loda da hotunan bangare.
strings.settings_terminal_desc: Yana gudanar da shigar software ɗinku a cikin Terminal don ku iya ganin bayanan fasaha akan ci gaba.
strings.settings_terminal_desc_windows: Yana gudanar da shigarwar software ɗin ku a cikin Umurnin Ba da izini don ku iya ganin bayanan fasaha akan ci gaba.
strings.settings_sp_auth_desc: Na zaɓi. Wasu makasudin MediaTek sun ƙi yin walƙiya har sai an ba SP Flash Tool fayil ɗin tantancewa (.auth); ƙara naku anan idan na'urar tana buƙatar ɗaya.
strings.terminal_install_no_scatter: Ba a sami fayil mai watsawa a cikin wannan fakitin ba, don haka ba za a iya gina wani umarni na wasan bidiyo ba.
strings.terminal_install_no_tool: Babu SP Flash Tool ginawa ko MTKClient shigarwar da akwai don wannan hanyar.
strings.terminal_install_failed: An kasa buɗe taga tasha. An rubuta umarnin shigarwa zuwa {path}.
strings.status_terminal_install: Shigar da umarnin da aka buɗe a cikin taga tasha ({path}).
strings.terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} yanzu zai buɗe {method}.

• Idan bai riga ya kashe ba, kashe {device}.
• Idan an haɗa ta da USB, cire haɗin ta da farko.
{hint}
• Haɗa na'urarka zuwa kwamfutarka lokacin da taga {terminal_name} ta buɗe.

Danna Ok don ƙaddamar da fita Sabuntawa.
strings.terminal_hint_innioasis: • Tukwici: Idan na'urar ba ta haɗa kai tsaye ba, a hankali danna maɓallin sake saiti a cikin fil ɗin tare da faifan takarda yayin haɗa kebul na USB.
strings.terminal_hint_generic: • Tukwici: Saka na'urarka cikin yanayin zazzagewar firmware (ya bambanta ta samfuri: misali cire baturi kuma kiyaye shi tare da haɗin kebul na USB, ko kashe wuta tare da baturi a ciki, ko riƙe ƙarar ƙasa / sama yayin haɗa USB).
strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Shigar ta SP Flash Tool GUI
strings.sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI yanzu zai buɗe tare da shigar da firmware ɗin ku.

• A cikin SP Flash Tool, zaɓi "Format All + Download" daga jerin zaɓuka.
• Danna maɓallin "Download".
• Tabbatar cewa an kashe {device} ku kuma an cire haɗin.
{hint}
• Haɗa kebul na USB zuwa kwamfutarka bayan danna Zazzagewa.

Danna Ok don ƙaddamar da SP Flash Tool kuma fita Sabuntawa.

strings.themes_placement_failed_note: Ba mu sami ikon sanya fakitin jigogi akan mai kunna ku ba. Kuna iya sake gwadawa daga Saituna.

Sakin software na asali wanda ya girmi 3.0.7 ba su dace da raka'a Y1 da aka sayar da Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Yin walƙiya tsohuwar gini akan waɗannan raka'a zai hana su yin booting har sai an sake shigar da sabon sigar.

strings.settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Sakin Rockbox-Y1 kafin 0.5 bai dace da raka'o'in Y1 da aka sayar ba bayan Maris 2026 tare da Innioasis OS 3.0.7 da aka riga aka shigar.

Filki tsohuwar gini akan waɗannan na'urori zai hana yin booting.

Shin kun tabbata kuna son nuna tsoffin ginin Rockbox?

strings.settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Ajiye app ɗin a cikin mashaya menu bayan rufe taga, don haka har yanzu kuna samun sanarwar sabunta firmware da app da mai kunnawa. A kashe: rufe taga yana barin app.

strings.sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Da fatan za a cire haɗin USB, kunna kuma kunna cikin Rockbox sau ɗaya (don haka yana fara babban fayil ɗin tsarin .rockbox na ciki), sannan sake haɗa USB kuma zaɓi 'Yanayin Ajiya na USB'.

strings.sel_only_local: Zaɓi fakitin firmware na gida .zip ko .rar don shigarwa a layi - babu buƙatar intanet. Yana aiki tare da kowane Innioasis da Timmkoo mai kunna sauti.
strings.sel_only_local_generic: Zaɓi fakitin firmware na gida (.zip, .rar) ko babban fayil mai ɗauke da fayil ɗin watsawa don shigarwar layi - yana aiki tare da na'urorin MediaTek na gabaɗaya.
strings.sel_offline_install: Shigar da firmware daga fayil ɗin .zip ko .rar akan kowane Innioasis ko Timmkoo mai kunna sauti.

strings.single_instance_body: Wani kwafin yana buɗewa, ko kuma yana gudana a bango. Kwafi biyu za su yi gasa don haɗin kebul na mai kunnawa, don haka wannan ba zai fara ba.

strings.single_instance_force_failed: An kasa ƙare kwafin mai gudana. Bar shi da kanka, sa'an nan kuma fara sabuntawa kuma.
strings.single_instance_busy_body: Kwafin da ke gudana shine shigar da software ko magana da mai kunnawa, don haka ƙare shi yanzu zai katse hakan. Wannan ƙaddamarwa zai rufe; yi amfani da taga data kasance ko gunkin menu nasa lokacin da shigarwa ya ƙare.

strings.donate_completion_body: Sabuntawa kyauta ne, ba shi da tallace-tallace kuma ba shi da bin diddigi - yana gudana akan ƙananan gudummawa daga mutane kamar ku. Idan ya cece ku aiki a yau, siyan min kofi yana kiyaye abubuwan zazzagewa da sabar suna gudana.

Idan wannan shigar ya cece ku lokaci ko ya ceci na'urar ku a yau, siyan mana kofi yana sa abubuwan zazzagewa da sabar suna gudana don kowa da kowa.
strings.donate_completion_body_community: Ma'ajiyarmu ta firmware da kayan aikinmu ana kiyaye su akan layi ta tallafin al'umma. Kowane kofi yana ba da kuɗin sabar zazzagewar sauri mai sauri don mai kunnawa na gaba ya ji daɗin kiɗan su ma.

strings.support_story_1_headline: Lokacin da masana'antun suka ci gaba, al'umma suna haɓaka.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Kare na'urarka daga tarkon kayan aikin shiru da fashe-fashe bita.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis a kai a kai yana fitar da sabbin firmwares don 'yan wasa kamar Y1 (yana nufin bita-da-kullin allon allo kamar 6.0, 7.0, da 8.0) waɗanda ke karya tsofaffin na'urori cikin shiru. Mafi muni, gidan yanar gizon su yana ba da gargaɗin sifili da damar sifili zuwa na'urorin firmware na baya don murmurewa daga yanayin bulo. Sabuntawa da aikin Firmware na Community sun tattara guntu-guntu: muna adana kowane kayan gado na ROM, tabbatar da sake fasalin kayan aikinku ta atomatik, kuma kiyaye ɗan wasan ku yana gudana lafiya.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Ceto Ƴan wasan Karyayye: Binciken aminci yana tabbatar da sabbin abubuwan sabuntawa ba su taɓa tubalin tsofaffin kayan aikin ba.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: Hannun jari na ROMs: Cikakken tarin kayan aikin masana'anta na asali Innioasis an goge.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Ƙasar Cross-Platform: Cikakken kayan aikin walƙiya don macOS, Linux, da Windows iri ɗaya.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Gano allo ta atomatik don haka koyaushe kuna samun fakitin da ya dace.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Babu karya Google Drives. Babu zato-aiki. Kawai aiki firmware.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Babban sauri, ingantattun kayan aikin al'umma da za ku iya dogaro da su.
strings.support_story_2_body: Bibiyar software na Innioasis na hukuma yawanci yana nufin zazzage taron don hanyoyin haɗin Google Drive da suka ƙare, matattun girgije na Baidu, da fayilolin zip na sirri ba tare da kayan aikin walƙiya ba. Mun gina ingantaccen hanyar zazzagewa mai zaman kanta tare da ingantaccen amincin SHA-256, sabunta sanarwar, da shigarwar mataki-mataki. Gudunmawar ku kai tsaye tana kiyaye abubuwan zazzagewa da ɗaukar nauyi waɗanda ke ba da damar hakan awanni 24 a rana, kwanaki 365 a shekara.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: CDN Mai Saurin Kai tsaye: Mai sauri, zazzagewar kai tsaye ba tare da iyakoki na saukewa ko matattun hanyoyin haɗin yanar gizo ba.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Sabunta Fadakarwa: Samun faɗakarwa lokacin da sabbin fitowar al'umma ko gyare-gyare suka ragu.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Shirye-shiryen Matakai na Mataki-mataki: Tsare-tsare na gani yana tafiya da ku ta kowane latsa maɓallin.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Al'umman Harsuna da yawa: An keɓance cikakke cikin Ingilishi, Sinanci, Jamusanci, Sifen, Faransanci & Jafananci.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Buɗe cikakken damar ɗan wasan ku na Innioasis.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Kawo Rockbox, tsarin aiki marasa nauyi na al'ada, da 'yancin sauti.
strings.support_story_3_body: Software na masana'anta na hannun jari kawai yana zazzage saman abin da kayan aikin Y1 ko Y2 ɗinku zai iya yi. Al'ummarmu sun kawo Rockbox, tsarin aiki na al'ada mara nauyi, sake kunnawa codec audiophile, da jigogi na al'ada zuwa rayuwa. Muna siyan bambance-bambancen kayan aikin jiki daga aljihu don gwadawa, juyar da injiniyanci, da tabbatar da kowane shigarwa. Taimakawa Sabuntawa kai tsaye yana ba da kuɗin waɗannan rukunin gwajin kuma yana haɓaka haɓaka firmware na al'ada.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: Danna Rockbox Daya: An shigar da sake kunna sauti da jigogi na al'ada a cikin dakika.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Firmware Community: Haɓaka baturi, UI mai tsabta, da tallafin codec na zamani na zamani.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Lab Lab ɗin Hardware Mai Aiki: Muna gwada kan na'urori na zahiri kafin mu saki kowane gini.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% kyauta, software na farko na sirri ba tare da talla ko sa ido ba.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Taimaka mana muyi abin da Innioasis baya yi.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Kiyaye firmware mai ƙarfi na al'umma yana kiyaye na'urorin ku daga wuraren da ba a taɓa gani ba.
strings.support_story_4_body: Lokacin da kamfanin kayan masarufi ya matsa zuwa na'urarsu ta gaba, tsofaffin ƙira suna yin watsi da su. Innioasis yana ba da tallafin Linux, babu bayanan canji na gaskiya, kuma babu hanya mai sauƙi don murmurewa lokacin da shigarwa ya gaza. Sabuntawa yana wanzu saboda masu sha'awar masu amfani bai kamata su jefar da ingantaccen mai kunna kiɗan ba. 100% na gudummawar al'umma suna tafiya kai tsaye don buɗe wannan kayan aikin ga kowa da kowa.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Ceto & Cire tubalin: An tabbatar da dawowar yana gudana koda lokacin da na'urori suka ƙi yin taya.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Tallafi na Farko na Linux: Cikakken tallafin MediaTek yana walƙiya akan Linux distros.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Fassarar Canje-canje: Cikakken bayanin kula don ku san ainihin menene canje-canje.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: An Tallafawa Al'umma 100%: Kowane kofi yana buɗewa kuma kyauta ga kowa.

strings.err_sp_wrong_model: Mai kunnawa da aka haɗa wani samfuri ne daban fiye da wannan fakitin hari. Cire haɗin shi, sannan shigar da firmware da aka gina don wannan mai kunnawa.
strings.err_sp_timeout: Kayan aiki bai taba ganin mai kunnawa ba. Ci gaba da kashe shi kuma cire shi, sannan haɗa kebul na USB lokacin da aka sa.
strings.err_sp_brom_startcmd: Mai kunnawa yayi ƙarfi da wuri. Kashe shi gaba ɗaya, sannan sake haɗa shi.
strings.err_sp_download_fail: An katse rubutu. Duba kebul na USB da tashar jiragen ruwa da cajin baturi, sannan a sake gwadawa.
strings.err_sp_da_init_sync: Wakilin zazzagewa ya kasa farawa. Gwada sauran hanyar walƙiya.
strings.err_sp_brom_da_fail: Ba za a iya aika wakilin zazzagewa ga mai kunnawa ba. Kashe shi kuma sake haɗawa.
strings.err_sp_da_invalid_type: Wakilin saukewa mai aminci na na'urar ya ƙi wannan kunshin. Yi amfani da Download Agent da aka bayar tare da wannan firmware, ko sigar SP Flash Tool da yake buƙata.
strings.err_sp_com_port: Kayan aikin ba zai iya buɗe tashar tashar sa ba. Rufe wasu kayan aikin walƙiya kuma sake haɗawa.
strings.err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Ba za a iya buɗe tashar USB COM ba (kuskure 1013). Sake kunna kwamfutarka zai saki tashar da aka kulle. Da fatan za a sake kunna kwamfutarka kuma a sake gwadawa.
strings.err_sp_enable_dram: Kayan aikin ba zai iya fara ƙwaƙwalwar mai kunnawa ba. Yi amfani da kunshin da aka gina don wannan ainihin samfurin.
strings.err_sp_storage_read: Kayan aikin bai iya karanta ma'ajiyar mai kunnawa ba. Duba haɗin; na'urar na iya samun kuskuren hardware.
strings.err_attempt_timeout: Kayan aikin walƙiya ya nuna babu ci gaba a cikin daƙiƙa {seconds}, don haka an dakatar da wannan ƙoƙarin.
strings.err_connection_failed_desc: An kasa kafa tsayayyen haɗi tare da mai kunnawa. Tabbatar cewa an kashe na'urar (amfani da fil don danna maɓallin sake saiti idan an buƙata), cire USB, kuma sake haɗawa lokacin da aka sa.
strings.err_flash_write_failed_desc: An katse walƙiya ko aikin rubutu ya gaza. Bincika cewa kebul na USB yana da ƙarfi a ciki kuma baturin yana da isasshen caji, sannan sake gwadawa.
strings.err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Kayan aikin walƙiya ya nuna layi ɗaya na daƙiƙa {seconds} na ƙarshe kuma baya bayyana yana ci gaba da rubuta firmware. Wataƙila filasha ya gaza. Idan wannan shine na ƙarshe na ƙoƙari biyu tare da kowace hanya akan tsarin da zai iya komawa baya a tsakanin su, ko kuma idan MTKClient kawai yana samuwa akan wannan na'ura, sake kunna kwamfutar kuma a sake gwadawa.
strings.err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient kawai yana samuwa don wannan shigarwa. Wataƙila filasha ya gaza. Da fatan za a sake kunna kwamfutar kuma a sake gwadawa.
strings.err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Wannan kwamfutar kuma za ta iya shigarwa ta amfani da SP Flash Tool. Idan za ku iya, canza zuwa SP Flash Tool kuma a sake gwadawa.
strings.prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Wataƙila filasha ya gaza. Da fatan za a karanta sakon da ke sama kuma sake kunna kwamfutar kafin a sake gwadawa. Idan ka danna Ok, app ɗin zai daina don sake farawa.
strings.err_missing_package_files_desc: Fakitin firmware ya ɓace fayil ɗin watsawa ko fayilolin hoto da ake buƙata. Da fatan za a sake zazzage fakitin ko zaɓi cikakken fayil ɗin firmware.
strings.err_auth_file_unusable_title: Ba za a iya amfani da Fayil na tantancewa ba
strings.err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayil ɗin tantancewa da kuka zaɓa ya ɓace, fanko ko ba za a iya rubuta shi ba. Zaɓi fayil mai aiki, ko share shi a cikin Saituna, sa'an nan kuma yi walƙiya.
strings.err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ba za a iya ƙaddamar da kayan aikin walƙiya ko direbobin tsarin da ake buƙata ba. Da fatan za a duba izinin tsarin, saitin direba, ko sake shigar da aikace-aikacen.
strings.err_driver_missing_desc: Wannan kuskuren na iya faruwa lokacin da ba a shigar da direban USB na MediaTek ba. Danna Zazzage Drivers don shigar da direban USB na MediaTek, sake kunna kwamfutarka, sannan a sake gwadawa.
strings.err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayil na firmware da aka adana ya ɓace. Zaɓi Zaɓi Software don sake gina fayilolin da aka ciro ko zazzage ma'ajin firmware kuma. Wannan matsala ce ta fayil ɗin gida, ba batun haɗin USB ba.
strings.sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Koma zuwa Zaɓi Software don sake ginawa ko zazzage fakitin firmware.
strings.sel_cache_retry_select_release: Zaɓi sakin firmware don sake saukewa.
strings.err_generic_flash_failed_desc: An sami kuskuren da ba a zata ba yayin shigarwa ({detail}). Kashe mai kunnawa gabaɗaya, sake haɗawa lokacin da aka sa, sannan a sake gwadawa.
strings.flash_method_confirm: An canza hanyar shigar zuwa {method}. Tabbatar cewa an cire mai kunnawa kuma an kashe shi, sannan danna Next.
strings.flash_failover_note: {method} bai fara shigarwa ba. Bayan an kashe mai kunnawa kuma an cire shi, za a yi amfani da {other} maimakon.
strings.themepack_card_desc: Ya haɗa da kyawawan jigogi na al'umma, manyan bayanan baya, da kuma rubutun da aka ƙera musamman don nunin 360p.
strings.themepack_installed_success: An shigar da Kunshin Jigo na 360 cikin nasara!
strings.themepack_step1_title: Mataki 1: Haɗa a Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB
strings.themepack_step1_desc:
1. Kunna mai kunnawa ta hanyar riƙe maɓallin wuta.
2. Lokacin da Rockbox takalma, toshe kebul na USB a cikin kwamfutarka.
3. Idan aka sa akan allon mai kunnawa, tabbatar da yanayin Adana USB don haka na'urar ta bayyana azaman tuƙi.
strings.themepack_step2_title: Mataki 2: Zaɓi Duk wani Jaka a kan Mai kunnawa
strings.themepack_step2_desc: Saboda tsarin aiki (kamar macOS) suna ɓoye dotfiles (kamar .rockbox) ta tsohuwa, zaku iya zaɓar kowane babban fayil ko tushen tuƙi akan mai kunna ku. Za mu nemo ko ƙirƙirar ku ta atomatik.rockbox directory.
strings.themepack_complete: An yi nasarar shigar da fakitin jigo! Yanzu zaku iya cire haɗin mai kunna ku cikin aminci kuma zaɓi jigo a Rockbox (Saituna> Saitunan Jigo).
strings.themepack_err_not_found: Ba za a iya gano wuri ko fara .rockbox directory a kan zaɓaɓɓen drive ba. Da fatan za a tabbatar kun zaɓi babban fayil akan mai kunna ku.
strings.rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Tsallake zuwa Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Mataki 1: Sake kunna mai kunnawa kuma sake haɗawa
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Cire haɗin kebul na USB.
2. Ƙaddamar da mai kunnawa kuma bar shi ya shiga cikin Rockbox.
3. Da zarar Rockbox yana aiki, sake haɗa kebul na USB, sannan danna Ci gaba.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Mataki 2: Neman player a kan ADB ...
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Ka'idar tana kallon haɗin ADB (har zuwa daƙiƙa 30). Idan an samo na'ura, ana canja wurin jigogi kuma an sake kunna mai kunnawa ta atomatik. In ba haka ba, tsallake gaba zuwa Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Ana jiran na'urar ADB... (har zuwa 30 seconds)
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_found: An samo na'urar ({serial}); canja wurin jigogi...
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Babu na'urar ADB da aka gano a cikin daƙiƙa 30; Ci gaba da Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Babu binary ADB da ke samuwa ga app; Ci gaba da Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Tura jigogi da rubutu akan ADB...
strings.rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Canja wurin ADB ya gaza; komawa zuwa Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB
strings.rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Shigar ta Yanayin Ma'ajiya ta USB
strings.rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Kunna Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB akan mai kunnawa don ya bayyana azaman tuƙi.
2. Zaɓi kowane babban fayil akan mai kunnawa da ke ƙasa (.rockbox, Music, Jigogi, ko tushen tuƙi - babban fayil ɗin .rockbox mai ɓoye yana samuwa ta atomatik).
3. App ɗin yana haɗa jigogi 360p da fonts a ciki, suna sake rubuta fayilolin suna iri ɗaya.
strings.rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Yanzu zaku iya cire haɗin mai kunnawa cikin aminci kuma zaɓi jigo a cikin Rockbox (Saituna> Saitunan Jigo).

strings.rockbox_stage_pushing: An gano mai kunnawa. Ajiye jigogi & fonts...
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Riƙe maɓallin tsakiya don kunna Y1 ɗinku, sake haɗa USB, kuma zaɓi Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.
strings.rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Riƙe maɓallin wuta don kunna mai kunna ku, sake haɗa USB, kuma zaɓi Yanayin Ma'ajiya na USB.

strings.donate_support_appeal_bandwidth: Rumbun kayan aikin firmware yana motsa terabytes kowane wata. Taimako na biyan kuɗin bandwidth ɗin da ke isar da shi.
strings.donate_support_appeal_monthly_costs: Kudin gudu yana zuwa kusan $200 a wata. Duk abin da za ku iya ƙarawa yana rufe gibin.
strings.donate_support_appeal_small_change: Fam kaɗan suna tafiya mai nisa a nan: yana rufe bandwidth don ɗaruruwan shigarwa.
strings.donate_support_appeal_long_nights: Ana gyara kwari saboda wani ya tsaya tare da samfurin ku akan benci. Gudunmawa tana ci gaba da tafiya.
strings.donate_support_appeal_behind_the_scenes: Babu kamfani a bayan wannan, mai haɓakawa ɗaya kawai, benci na aiki da shafin bayar da gudummawa. Komai yana tafiya zuwa farashi mai gudana.
strings.donate_support_appeal_next_feature: Kayan aikin, jagorori da ma'ajiyar bayanai duk kyauta ne. Tukwici yana tallafawa fasalin na gaba.
strings.donate_support_appeal_kindness: Idan wannan ya yi aiki a gare ku, aika alheri a kan. Yana ba da aikin kyauta ga duk wanda ya zo na gaba.
strings.donate_support_appeal_rescue: Wasu daga cikin 'yan wasan wannan tallafin an rubuta su a matsayin karye. Taimako yana sa sabis na ceto yana gudana.
strings.donate_support_appeal_no_subscription: Babu biyan kuɗi, babu ranar ƙarshe, kawai shafi kamar wannan. Ba da kawai idan ya taimaka.
strings.donate_support_appeal_one_person: Mutum ɗaya yana amsa batutuwan, ya rubuta jagororin kuma yana biyan kuɗi. Taimako na sa hakan ya dore.
strings.donate_support_appeal_archive_forever: Firmware yana ɓacewa lokacin da runduna ta rufe. Gudunmawa suna adana kwafin da ya ceci ɗan wasan ku akan layi.
strings.donate_support_appeal_coffee_math: Kofi ɗaya yana ɗaukar kusan bandwidth na zazzagewa. Yana kiyaye gyara na gaba cikin isarwa.
strings.donate_family_appeal_expected: Ryan da abokin tarayya suna jiran jariri. Ba da gudummawa ga farashin tafiyar da aikin da sabon danginmu ana yabawa sosai.
strings.donate_family_appeal_new_arrival: Akwai sabon shigowa akan hanya a gidan Ryan. Kowane gudummawa ga sabobin da dangin mu na girma yana da ma'ana mai girma.
strings.donate_family_appeal_nursery: Ryan da abokin tarayya suna shirye don ɗansu. Idan wannan kayan aikin ya kasance mai amfani, gudummawa don farashi mai gudana da danginmu masu girma zai taimaka fiye da yadda kuka sani.
